text_simplified: Tarbiyah (upbringing) of children is a great responsibility that falls upon the shoulders of parents. Neglecting or failing in it is the primary cause of children's corruption. Every father must take care of the tarbiyah of his children with a righteous upbringing, for a person's deeds come to an end after their death except for three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who supplicates for them.
